useRelogin.note: reissues access token AND rotates sessionId; sets session cache. Use after profile/role changes. On failure (401) the backend replies `{ status: "ERR", message: "Can not relogin" }`.

useUserSessions.returns: UserSessionRecord[] — bare array, no envelope; `currentOne: true` flags the active session

useDeleteUserSession.note: revokes single session; invalidates userSessions cache

useDeleteAllSessions.note: revokes all sessions; current user must re-login

types.SessionResponse: Flat envelope returned by login / relogin / social-exchange. Fields at the top level: status, accessToken, sessionId, userId, roleId, email?, fullname?, avatar?, mobile?, emailVerified?, mobileVerified?, registeredAt?, loginAt?, agent?, checkTokenMark?, tenantCodename? (multi-tenant), plus any custom user properties. NOT nested under `user`. The accessToken is the only token the frontend needs — DbBucket / RemoteBucket uploads authenticate with it directly.
types.CurrentUserResponse: Same flat fields as SessionResponse plus session metadata: source ("redis"|"db"|"cache"), expiresAt, lastActiveAt, lastActiveIp. When no user is logged in, getCurrentUser() resolves to `null` (instead of throwing) — the backend HTTP 401 is caught.
types.UserResponse: { user: User, ...envelope } — nested. Used by user CRUD endpoints (GET/PATCH/DELETE /v1/users/:id).
